svg.aria-label: A lookup chart for the warning lights. Expected, not a fault: with the key on and the engine off the red oil-pressure lamp, the charge lamp and the check-engine lamp are lit; after the start, oil and charge go out within seconds and the check-engine lamp goes out unless a fault asks for it; the DSC and ABS lamps stay on until Session 5. To tell lamp wiring from a real fault, read STAT_MIL_EIN: at 0 with the check-engine lamp lit while the engine runs, suspect the cluster or its coding; at 1, read FS_LESEN. Then each lamp with its likely causes, most likely first, and the first check. Check engine: the leak-test circuit, SMG software in the DME, the O2 sensors or their heaters, secondary air, injector circuits, throttle or pedal, misfire. No lamp but faults stored: the pump fault 1 (0x01), expected with US software on K96; possibly 130 (0x82) after an EWS delete; 110 (0x6E) if the Sport LED isn't wired. Oil pressure, out at key-on: the pin-11 wire or the cluster's CAN setting; on while running: low oil pressure or a grounded lamp wire. Charge, out at key-on: the pin-1 wire or GENERATOR_UEBER_CAN; on while running: alternator, belt, the terminal-61 wire, low voltage; with a donor built from 03/2004, if the lamp stays dark with GENERATOR_UEBER_CAN at nicht_aktiv, code it aktiv. Oil level: the pin-21 wire, TOG_UEBER_CAN, or the sensor, fault 44 (0x2C). EML: the throttle sensors, pedal, synchronization or actuator, low charging voltage, or the adaptation not done. ABS, DSC and brake: the VIN not initialized until the cluster carries your VIN, wheel-speed sensors, steering angle, an M3 MK60, or the brake test-contact wire still on pin 28. Cruise won't engage: not the M3 clutch module, the gear switch, implausible brake contacts, SMG software, the steering-wheel data line. Airbag: a seat swap or the slip-ring plugs; never bypass it, since its crash message starts the DME's pump cut-off, unverified with K96. Gearbox or SMG lamp and tamper dot: SMG software or cluster and light-module coding. Check filler cap: the cap, or a leak.
svg.text: Expected, not a fault. Key on, engine off: the red
oil-pressure lamp, the charge lamp and the
check-engine lamp lit. After the start, oil and charge
go out within seconds, and check engine unless a
fault asks for it. DSC and ABS lamps stay on until
Session 5.
Check-engine lamp lit with the engine running: wiring or a real fault?
Read STAT_MIL_EIN.
0 with the lamp lit: suspect the
cluster or its coding.
1: read FS_LESEN, then see
Check engine below.
LAMPS AND SYMPTOMS: LIKELY CAUSES, MOST LIKELY FIRST, AND THE FIRST CHECK
Check engine: 1 Leak-test circuit: heater 14 (0x0E), valve
27 (0x1B), module 127 (0x7F), after the pin moves or with a
three-wire module. 2 SMG software in the DME (SMG bus
faults, "MIL request from SMG"). 3 O2 sensors or their
heaters, faults 37–40 (0x25–0x28): a wrong or mixed O2
harness. 4 Secondary air, faults 19, 63, 170 and 171 (0x13,
0x3F, 0xAA, 0xAB). 5 Injector circuits (an X6053 mix).
6 Throttle or pedal (the EML lamp too). 7 Misfire.
Check: STAT_MIL_EIN; FS_LESEN with its stored values; the
leak-test triangle (step 9); START_SYSTEMCHECK_DMTL and
LESEN_SYSTEMCHECK_DMTL; STEUERN_SLS_CHECK
No lamp, but faults stored: location 1 (0x01), the pump
fault, expected with US software on K96; possibly 130 (0x82)
after an EWS delete; 110 (0x6E) if the Sport LED isn't wired.
Check: FS_LESEN, and confirm STAT_MIL_EIN = 0
Oil pressure (red), out at key-on: the pin-11 wire missing or
on the wrong cluster pin, or the cluster expects oil pressure
over CAN (CAN_OELDRUCKSCHALTER). On while running: low
oil pressure, or the lamp wire grounded.
Check: the key-on lamp; power-up steps 3 and 4; a mechanical gauge
Charge, out at key-on: the pin-1 wire, or
GENERATOR_UEBER_CAN; with a donor built from 03/2004, if
it stays dark at nicht_aktiv, code it aktiv. On while
running: alternator, belt, the terminal-61 wire to X60003 pin
13, low voltage.
Check: the key-on lamp; STATUS_UBATT running
Oil level (yellow): the pin-21 wire to cluster pin 17, or
TOG_UEBER_CAN; the sensor itself, fault 44 (0x2C).
Check: STATUS_OEL_TEMPERATUR reads plausibly
EML: throttle sensor 1 or 2, the pedal, throttle
synchronization, the actuator; low charging voltage;
adaptation not done.
Check: faults 118–121 (0x76–0x79), 60 and 61 (0x3C, 0x3D),
ABS, DSC, brake: 1 VIN not initialized (5EF1, 5E1F) until the
cluster carries your VIN. 2 Wheel-speed sensors: an MK20
donor's don't fit. 3 Steering angle not calibrated. 4 An M3
MK60 that won't accept the Touring. 5 The yellow brake lamp:
the brake test-contact wire still on pin 28.
Check: INPA's DSC fault memory and wheel speeds
Cruise won't engage: 1 Not the M3 clutch module. 2 Gear
switch missing or open. 3 Brake contacts implausible,
fault 106 (0x6A). 4 SMG software. 5 Steering-wheel data line,
fault 81 (0x51).
Check: STAT_KRAFTSCHLUSS_EIN in gear; STAT_BLS_EIN,
STAT_BLTS_EIN; STAT_MFL1_EIN…; faults 80 (0x50), 106 (0x6A),
Airbag: a seat swap (belt tensioners, occupancy mat), the
steering wheel's slip-ring plugs. Never bypass it: its crash
message starts the DME's pump cut-off (unverified with K96).
Check: INPA's airbag fault memory
Gearbox or SMG lamp; tamper dot: SMG software; cluster
and light module not re-coded after a vehicle-order change;
the cluster's VIN or mileage not matching the light module's.
Check: the DME's software; the cluster coding
"Check filler cap": the cap not sealing; a leak found after
refueling.
Check: LESEN_SYSTEMCHECK_DMTL; fault 181 (0xB5)
